headline: A creative studio needed to be formally registered across every service it offers.
challenge: Creative businesses often offer several services at once. The registration had to cover the full range of work so the business could trade, invoice and grow under one registered name.
delivered: Business name registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission under CAMA 2020
Nature of business recorded as media studio, graphic design, printing, projection and photography
Principal place of business registered in Enugu State
impact: A formally registered creative studio, ready to serve clients across design, printing, projection and photography under its own registered name.
